## Fonction utile 

```{r}
make_df_lineage <- function(lb1_dat, h3k9_dat, col_idx) {
  data.frame(
    chr   = lb1_dat$V1,
    start = as.numeric(lb1_dat$V2),
    end   = as.numeric(lb1_dat$V3),
    LB1   = as.numeric(lb1_dat[[col_idx]]),
    H3K9  = as.numeric(h3k9_dat[[col_idx]])
  )
}

scale_no_na <- function(x){
  
  m <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  s <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  (x - m) / s
  
}

plot_pheatmap_LB1_H3K9 <- function(df, lineage_name) {
  # z-score des signaux
  df$LB1_z  <- scale_no_na(df$LB1)
  df$H3K9_z <- scale_no_na(df$H3K9)

  cor_mat <- cor(
    cbind(df$LB1_z, df$H3K9_z),
    use = "complete.obs",
    method = "spearman"
  )
  rownames(cor_mat) <- colnames(cor_mat) <- c("LB1", "H3K9me2")

  pheatmap(
    cor_mat,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    display_numbers = TRUE,
    number_format = "%.2f",
    main = paste0("Corrélation LB1 vs H3K9me2 – ", lineage_name, ", chr18"),
    fontsize_number = 14,
    legend_labels = "Spearman"
  )
}

####################

plot_lb1_chr1 <- function(path_tab, title_prefix, out_prefix = NULL) {
  tab <- read.table(
    path_tab,
    header = TRUE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    comment.char = "#"
  )

  mat <- as.matrix(tab[, 4:6])
  colnames(mat) <- c("ESC", "ParaxMesoderm", "Cardiac")

  mat_z <- apply(mat, 2, scale_no_na)
  rownames(mat_z) <- paste(tab$chrom, tab$start, tab$end, sep = ":")

  keep_rows <- apply(mat_z, 1, function(v) all(is.finite(v)))
  mat_z_filt <- mat_z[keep_rows, , drop = FALSE]

  # --- Heatmap z-score ---

  # plot
  pheatmap(
    mat_z_filt,
    cluster_rows   = FALSE,
    cluster_cols   = TRUE,
    show_rownames  = FALSE,
    main           = paste0(title_prefix, " – z-score"),
    width          = 5,
    height         = 10
  )

  # sauvegarde 
  if (!is.null(out_prefix)) {
    pheatmap(
      mat_z_filt,
      cluster_rows   = FALSE,
      cluster_cols   = TRUE,
      show_rownames  = FALSE,
      main           = paste0(title_prefix, " – z-score"),
      filename       = paste0(out_prefix, "_zscore.png"),
      width          = 5,
      height         = 10
    )
  }

  ## --- Discrétisation quartiles ---

  vals <- as.vector(mat_z_filt)
  brks <- quantile(vals, probs = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1), na.rm = TRUE)

  mat_disc <- matrix(
    as.numeric(cut(
      vals,
      breaks = brks,
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      labels = 1:4
    )),
    nrow = nrow(mat_z_filt),
    ncol = ncol(mat_z_filt)
  )

  rownames(mat_disc) <- rownames(mat_z_filt)
  colnames(mat_disc) <- colnames(mat_z_filt)

  # Plot
  pheatmap(
    mat_disc,
    cluster_rows   = FALSE,
    cluster_cols   = TRUE,
    show_rownames  = FALSE,
    main           = paste0(title_prefix, " – scores quartiles (1–4)"),
    width          = 5,
    height         = 10,
    color          = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(4)
  )

  # sauvegarde
  if (!is.null(out_prefix)) {
    pheatmap(
      mat_disc,
      cluster_rows   = FALSE,
      cluster_cols   = TRUE,
      show_rownames  = FALSE,
      main           = paste0(title_prefix, " – scores quartiles (1–4)"),
      filename       = paste0(out_prefix, "_quartiles.png"),
      width          = 5,
      height         = 10,
      color          = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(4)
    )
  }
}
```

```{r}
# ---------- Région 65–75 Mb ----------
tab65 <- read.table("Data_Tab/bin50k/LB1_chr7_65_75.tab",
                    header = TRUE,
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                    comment.char = "#")

colnames(tab65)

# Matrice avec 3 colonnes coord (chrom, start, end) + 12 colonnes de signal
mat65 <- as.matrix(tab65[, 4:ncol(tab65)])

colnames(mat65) <- c("ESC", "APS",
                     "DefEcto", "Midbrain", "BorderEcto",
                     "ParaxMesoderm", "EarlySomite", "EndoProg",
                     "Cardiac", "Epicard", "MidHindgut", "Liver")

cor65 <- cor(mat65, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

pheatmap(cor65,
         clustering_method = "complete",
         main = "Corrélations LB1 - chr7:65.5–75 Mb")

# ---------- Région 75–130 Mb ----------
```

## Heatmap LB1 ESC / Cardiac / ParaMeso

```{r}
#--------------------- ESC / Cardiac / ParaMeso Genome --------------

tab_Genome = read.table("Data_Tab/bin100k/LB1_ESC_Parax_Cardiac_genome_100kb.tab",
                        header = TRUE,
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                        comment.char = "#")

mat_3genome <- as.matrix(tab_Genome[, 4:ncol(tab_Genome)])

colnames(mat_3genome) <- c("ESC", "ParaxMesoderm", "Cardiac")

mat_3genome_scaled <- apply(mat_3genome, 2, scale_no_na)
mat_3genome_scaled <- as.matrix(mat_3genome_scaled)
colnames(mat_3genome_scaled) <- colnames(mat_3genome)

#--------------------- whole Genome --------------

tabAll <- read.table("Data_Tab/bin100k/LB1_genome_100kb.tab",
                     header = TRUE,
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                     comment.char = "#")

# colonnes 1–3 = chr / start / end, le reste = 12 lignées
matAll <- as.matrix(tabAll[, 4:ncol(tabAll)])

colnames(matAll) <- c(
  "ESC", "APS",
  "DefEcto", "Midbrain", "BorderEcto",
  "ParaxMesoderm", "EarlySomite", "EndoProg",
  "Cardiac", "Epicard", "MidHindgut", "Liver"
)

matAll_scaled <- apply(matAll, 2, scale_no_na)
matAll_scaled <- as.matrix(matAll_scaled)
colnames(matAll_scaled) <- colnames(matAll)

#---------------------- HEATMAP -------------------

cor_genome <- cor(mat_3genome_scaled,
                  method = "spearman",
                  use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

corAll <- cor(matAll_scaled,
              method = "spearman",
              use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

pheatmap(cor_genome,
         clustering_method = "complete",
         main = "Corrélation LB1 scale - ESC / ParaxMesoderm / Cardiac")

pheatmap(corAll,
          clustering_method = "complete",
          main = "Corrélations LB1 scalées – whole genome (bins 100 kb)"
)


```

```{r}


distAll <- as.dist(1 - corAll)

hcAll <- hclust(distAll, method = "complete")

plot(hcAll,
     main = "Clustering hiérarchique – LB1 scale",
     xlab = "", sub = "")


rect.hclust(hcAll, k = 3, border = "red")

groupsAll <- cutree(hcAll, k = 3)
groupsAll
```

## Analyse Chromosome 18 LB1 vs H3K9

Nous remarquons sur UCSC que la région 5.6 Mb - 10.8 mb (bras long du chromosome)

```{r}

lb1_Esc_ParaMe_Card  <- read.table(
  "Data_Tab/bin50k/LB1_chr18_ESC_Parax_Cardiac_50kb.tab",
  header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, sep = "\t", quote = ""
)

h3k9_Esc_ParaMe_Card <- read.table(
  "Data_Tab/bin50k/H3K9_chr18_ESC_Parax_Cardiac_50kb.tab",
  header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, sep = "\t", quote = ""
)

# Pour éviter de refaire de nouveaux fichier tab, on va juste filtrer le track souhaité
# On doit donc garder exceptionnellement le header qui est en commentaire "#"

lb1_3types_dat  <- lb1_Esc_ParaMe_Card[-1, ]
h3k9_3types_dat <- h3k9_Esc_ParaMe_Card[-1, ]

# =========== Cardiac Nuage =========

df_card  <- make_df_lineage(lb1_3types_dat, h3k9_3types_dat, 6)
df_card$LB1_z  <- scale_no_na(df_card$LB1)
df_card$H3K9_z <- scale_no_na(df_card$H3K9)

# Corrélation LB1 vs H3K9me2 sur chr18
cor_chr18_card <- cor(df_card$LB1_z, df_card$H3K9_z,
                      method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
cor_chr18_card


ggplot(df_card, aes(x = LB1_z, y = H3K9_z)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.7) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Cardiac – chr18, LB1 vs H3K9me2 (50 kb, signaux scalés)",
    x = "LB1 (z-score)",
    y = "H3K9me2 (z-score)"
  )

# ====== ESC / ParaMeso / Cardiac HEATMAP ======


df_ESC   <- make_df_lineage(lb1_3types_dat, h3k9_3types_dat, 4)
df_Parax <- make_df_lineage(lb1_3types_dat, h3k9_3types_dat, 5)

df_ESC$LB1_z  <- scale_no_na(df_ESC$LB1)
df_Parax$H3K9_z <- scale_no_na(df_Parax$H3K9)

plot_pheatmap_LB1_H3K9(df_ESC,   "ESC")
plot_pheatmap_LB1_H3K9(df_Parax, "ParaxMesoderm")
plot_pheatmap_LB1_H3K9(df_card,  "Cardiac")


```

```{r}

mat_chr18 <- cbind(
  ESC_LB1   = as.numeric(lb1_Esc_ParaMe_Card$V4),
  Parax_LB1 = as.numeric(lb1_Esc_ParaMe_Card$V5),
  Card_LB1  = as.numeric(lb1_Esc_ParaMe_Card$V6),
  ESC_H3K9  = as.numeric(h3k9_Esc_ParaMe_Card$V4),
  Parax_H3K9= as.numeric(h3k9_Esc_ParaMe_Card$V5),
  Card_H3K9 = as.numeric(h3k9_Esc_ParaMe_Card$V6)
)

mat_chr18 <- mat_chr18[complete.cases(mat_chr18), ]

mat_chr18_z <- apply(mat_chr18, 2, scale_no_na)
cor_tracks <- cor(mat_chr18_z, use = "pairwise.complete.obs",
                  method = "spearman")

annotation_col <- data.frame(
  Marque   = c("LB1", "LB1", "LB1", "H3K9me2", "H3K9me2", "H3K9me2"),
  Lignée   = c("ESC", "Parax", "Cardiac", "ESC", "Parax", "Cardiac")
)
row.names(annotation_col) <- colnames(cor_tracks)

pheatmap(
  cor_tracks,
  clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
  clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
  clustering_method = "average",
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  display_numbers = TRUE,
  number_format = "%.2f",
  main = "Heatmap – LB1 vs H3K9me2 (chr18)",
  fontsize_number = 10
)

#================

dist_tracks <- as.dist(1 - cor_tracks)
hc_tracks <- hclust(dist_tracks, method = "average")


plot(hc_tracks, main = "Clustering hiérarchique – LB1 & H3K9me2 (chr18)")


rect.hclust(hc_tracks, k = 2, border = "red")

```

```{r}

lb1_all <- read.table(
  "Data_TAB/bin50k/LB1_rep1_rep2_genome_50kb.tab",
  header = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  sep = "\t",
  comment.char = "#"
)

# colonnes 1–3 = coord, le reste = signaux
mat <- as.matrix(lb1_all[, 4:ncol(lb1_all)])
mode(mat) <- "numeric"

new_names <- c(
  "ESC_r1", "APS_r1", "BorderEcto_r1", "Midbrain_r1",
  "DefEcto_r1", "EarlySomite_r1", "EndoProg_r1",
  "Epicard_r1", "MidHindgut_r1", "Liver_r1",
  "ParaxMesoderm_r1", "Cardiac_r1",
  "ESC_r2", "APS_r2", "BorderEcto_r2", "Midbrain_r2",
  "DefEcto_r2", "EarlySomite_r2", "EndoProg_r2",
  "Epicard_r2", "Liver_r2", "MidHindgut_r2",
  "ParaxMesoderm_r2", "Cardiac_r2"
)

colnames(mat) <- new_names

mat_t <- t(mat)   # échantillons x bins

# variance de chaque bin à travers les échantillons
var_bins <- apply(mat_t, 2, function(v) var(v, na.rm = TRUE))

# garder les bins informatifs (variance > 0, finie)
keep_cols <- which(is.finite(var_bins) & var_bins > 0)
length(keep_cols)

mat_t_filt <- mat_t[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]
dim(mat_t_filt)

# ===== ACP ====

pca_all <- prcomp(mat_t_filt, scale. = TRUE)

samples <- rownames(mat_t_filt)

# rep1 / rep2
Rep <- ifelse(grepl("_r1$", samples), "rep1", "rep2")

# lignée sans le suffixe
Lineage <- sub("_r[12]$", "", samples)

df_pca <- data.frame(
  sample  = samples,
  PC1     = pca_all$x[, 1],
  PC2     = pca_all$x[, 2],
  Rep     = Rep,
  Lineage = Lineage
)

head(df_pca)

# ==============

ggplot(df_pca,
       aes(x = PC1, y = PC2,
           color = Lineage, shape = Rep, label = Lineage)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(vjust = -0.7, size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "ACP LB1 (rep1 vs rep2, génome entier, 50 kb)",
    x = "PC1",
    y = "PC2",
    color = "Lignée",
    shape = "Rep"
  )


```

```{r}

tab <- read.table(
  "Data_TAB/bin10k/LB1_ESC_vs_H3K9_chr1_10kb.tab",
  header = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  sep = "\t",
  comment.char = "#"
)

# colonnes 1–3 = coord, le reste = signaux
mat <- as.matrix(tab[, 4:ncol(tab)])
mode(mat) <- "numeric"

colnames(mat) <- c(
  "ESC_LB1",
  "ESC_H3K9", "APS_H3K9", "BorderEcto_H3K9", "Midbrain_H3K9",
  "DefEcto_H3K9", "EarlySomite_H3K9", "EndoProg_H3K9",
  "Epicard_H3K9", "MidHindgut_H3K9", "Liver_H3K9",
  "ParaxMesoderm_H3K9"
)

mat_z <- apply(mat, 2, scale_no_na)
rownames(mat_z) <- paste(tab$chrom, tab$start, tab$end, sep = ":")

# on enlève NA/Inf
keep_rows <- apply(mat_z, 1, function(v) all(is.finite(v)))
mat_z_filt <- mat_z[keep_rows, , drop = FALSE]

pheatmap(
  mat_z_filt,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  main = "LB1 ESC et H3K9me2 – chr1 (10 kb, z-score)"
)

# heatmap  corrélations  pistes
cor_mat <- cor(mat_z_filt, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

  cor_mat,
  main = "Corrélations – ESC LB1 vs H3K9me2 (chr1, 10 kb)",
  display_numbers = TRUE
)
```

```{r}

tab100 <- read.table(
  "Data_Tab/bin100k/LB1_chr1_ESC_Parax_Cardiac_100kb.tab",
  header = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

colnames(tab100) <- c("chr", "start", "end",
                      "ESC", "ParaxMesoderm", "Cardiac")

mat100 <- as.matrix(tab100[, 4:6])
mode(mat100) <- "numeric"

scale_no_na <- function(x) {
  m <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  s <- sd(x,   na.rm = TRUE)
  (x - m) / s
}

mat100_z <- apply(mat100, 2, scale_no_na)
mat100_z <- as.matrix(mat100_z)

#NA/Inf
keep_rows100 <- apply(mat100_z, 1, function(v) all(is.finite(v)))
mat100_z_filt <- mat100_z[keep_rows100, , drop = FALSE]
tab100_filt   <- tab100[keep_rows100, ]

#----------------------------


# Détection bins hiérarchiques


df100 <- cbind(
  tab100_filt[, 1:3],              # chr / start / end
  as.data.frame(mat100_z_filt)     # ESC / Parax / Cardiac z-score
)
colnames(df100)[1:3] <- c("chr", "start", "end")

head(df100)

df100$d1 <- df100$ParaxMesoderm - df100$ESC
df100$d2 <- df100$Cardiac      - df100$ParaxMesoderm


# Seuil (en z-score)
threshold <- 0.3

df100 <- df100 %>%
  mutate(
    pattern = case_when(
      d1 >  threshold & d2 >  threshold ~ "ESC < Parax < Cardiac",
      d1 < -threshold & d2 < -threshold ~ "ESC > Parax > Cardiac",
      TRUE ~ "Non hiérarchique / similaire"
    )
  )

df100_hier <- df100 %>%
  filter(pattern != "Non hiérarchique / similaire") %>%
  mutate(region_id = row_number())

#--------------------

summary_patterns <- df100 %>%
  count(pattern) %>%
  mutate(freq = n / sum(n))

summary_patterns

ggplot(summary_patterns,
       aes(x = pattern, y = freq, fill = pattern)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Répartition des bins selon l'ordre ESC / Parax / Cardiac (LB1, chr1, 100 kb)",
    x = "",
    y = "Proportion de bins"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none")

prop.table(table(df100$pattern))


```

```{r}
df_hier <- df100[df100$pattern != "Non hiérarchique / similaire", ]

df_hier$mid <- (df_hier$start + df_hier$end) / 2

ggplot(df_hier, aes(x = mid, y = pattern, color = pattern)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Position sur chr1 (bp)",
    y = "",
    title = "Position des bins hiérarchiques sur chr1 (LB1, 100 kb)"
  )

```
Tentative pour 10kb en local

```{r}

# --- chr1, 10 kb global ---

tab10 <- read.table(
  "Data_Tab/bin10k/LB1_chr1_ESC_Parax_Cardiac_10kb.tab",
  header = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

colnames(tab10) <- c("chr", "start", "end",
                     "ESC", "ParaxMesoderm", "Cardiac")

mat10 <- as.matrix(tab10[, 4:6])
mode(mat10) <- "numeric"

mat10_z <- apply(mat10, 2, scale_no_na)
mat10_z <- as.matrix(mat10_z)

keep_rows10   <- apply(mat10_z, 1, function(v) all(is.finite(v)))
mat10_z_filt  <- mat10_z[keep_rows10, , drop = FALSE]
tab10_filt    <- tab10[keep_rows10, ]

df10 <- cbind(
  tab10_filt[, 1:3],
  as.data.frame(mat10_z_filt)
)
colnames(df10)[1:3] <- c("chr", "start", "end")



###############


# pour chaque bin 100 kb hiérarchique, on prend les 10 kb inclus
sub_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(df100_hier)), function(i){
  r <- df100_hier[i, ]
  sub <- df10 %>%
    filter(chr == r$chr,
           start >= r$start,
           end   <= r$end)
  if (nrow(sub) == 0) return(NULL)
  sub$parent_pattern <- r$pattern
  sub$region_id      <- r$region_id
  sub
})

df10_local <- do.call(rbind, sub_list)
dim(df10_local)
head(df10_local)


################

df10_local <- df10_local %>%
  mutate(
    d1_10 = ParaxMesoderm - ESC,
    d2_10 = Cardiac       - ParaxMesoderm,
    pattern10 = case_when(
      d1_10 >  threshold & d2_10 >  threshold ~ "ESC < Parax < Cardiac",
      d1_10 < -threshold & d2_10 < -threshold ~ "ESC > Parax > Cardiac",
      TRUE ~ "Non hiérarchique / similaire"
    )
  )

###################

local_summary <- df10_local %>%
  group_by(region_id, parent_pattern) %>%
  summarise(
    n_bins   = n(),
    n_same   = sum(pattern10 == parent_pattern),
    prop_same = n_same / n_bins,
    start100 = min(start),
    end100   = max(end),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

local_summary

# Résumé par région
df_prop <- local_summary %>%
  dplyr::select(region_id,
                parent_pattern,
                prop_keep = prop_same)


###############

ggplot(local_summary,
       aes(x = parent_pattern, y = prop_same, color = parent_pattern)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, height = 0, size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Stabilité des motifs hiérarchiques à 10 kb\n(dans les régions hiérarchiques à 100 kb)",
    x = "Motif à 100 kb",
    y = "Proportion de bins 10 kb avec le même ordre"
  )

ggplot(local_summary,
       aes(x = (start100 + end100)/2,
           y = prop_same,
           color = parent_pattern)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Cohérence locale (10 kb) des régions hiérarchiques (100 kb)\nLB1, chr1",
    x = "Position sur chr1 (bp)",
    y = "Proportion de bins 10 kb cohérents"
  )

```
```{r}

table(df100$pattern) / nrow(df100)

# Proportions 10 kb par motif parent
df_prop %>%
  group_by(parent_pattern) %>%
  summarise(
    median_prop = median(prop_keep),
    q1 = quantile(prop_keep, 0.25),
    q3 = quantile(prop_keep, 0.75)
  )

```
